neet_che_u04_t08_1.working: ΔG = ΔH − TΔS. With ΔH > 0 and ΔS > 0, ΔG becomes negative only when TΔS > ΔH, i.e. T > ΔH/ΔS.

neet_che_u04_t08_2.working: Crossover T = ΔH/ΔS = 180000/150 = 1200 K. Since ΔS > 0, ΔG < 0 above 1200 K.

neet_che_u04_t08_4.working: A is true: thermodynamic spontaneity says nothing about rate, which is a kinetic matter. R is a true fact about −ΔG being the maximum non-pV work, but it does not explain rate.

neet_che_u04_t08_5.working: I: at constant T and P, ΔS_total = ΔS_sys − ΔH/T, so ΔG = −TΔS_total; I is correct. II: at 300 K, ΔG = −120 + 90 = −30 kJ/mol (negative); at 500 K, ΔG = −120 + 150 = +30 kJ/mol (positive); II is correct.
